#!/bin/sh
set -e

echo "============================================="
echo "Git-Sync Deployment Controller"
echo "Target: prediction-markets"
echo "Sync Interval: 60 seconds"
echo "Repository: https://github.com/ardenone/kalshi-trading.git"
echo "============================================="
echo ""

LAST_COMMIT=""

while true; do
  echo "[$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")] Checking for changes..."

  # Check if git sync is working
  if [ ! -L "/git/current" ]; then
    echo "WARNING: /git/current symlink not found. Waiting for git-sync..."
    sleep 60
    continue
  fi

  # Get current commit hash
  CURRENT_COMMIT=$(cat /git/current/.git/HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")

  if [ "$CURRENT_COMMIT" != "$LAST_COMMIT" ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "=== NEW COMMIT DETECTED ==="
    echo "Previous: $LAST_COMMIT"
    echo "Current: $CURRENT_COMMIT"
    echo ""

    # Check if directory exists
    if [ -d "/git/current/k8s/apexalgo-iad/prediction-markets/" ]; then
      echo "Applying manifests from prediction-markets directory..."
      echo ""

      # Create namespace if needed
      echo "Step 1/2: Creating namespace..."
      kubectl apply -f /git/current/k8s/apexalgo-iad/prediction-markets/namespace.yml 2>&1 || true
      echo ""

      # Wait for namespace to be active
      echo "Waiting for namespace to be Active..."
      kubectl wait --for=jsonpath='{.status.phase}'=Active namespace/prediction-markets --timeout=30s 2>&1 || true
      echo ""

      # Apply all resources
      echo "Step 2/2: Applying all resources..."
      kubectl apply -k /git/current/k8s/apexalgo-iad/prediction-markets/ 2>&1

      echo ""
      echo "=== DEPLOYMENT COMPLETE ==="
      echo "Timestamp: $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")"
      echo "Commit: $CURRENT_COMMIT"
      echo ""

      # Show current state
      kubectl get all,configmap,servicemonitor -n prediction-markets 2>&1 || true
      echo ""

      # Update last commit
      LAST_COMMIT="$CURRENT_COMMIT"
    else
      echo "WARNING: prediction-markets directory not found in /git/current/"
      echo "Expected: /git/current/k8s/apexalgo-iad/prediction-markets/"
    fi
  else
    echo "No changes detected (commit: $CURRENT_COMMIT)"
  fi

  echo ""
  echo "Sleeping for 60 seconds..."
  echo "============================================="
  echo ""
  sleep 60
done

#!/usr/bin/env sh
set -eux
# Sleep for a good long while before exiting.
# This is to allow folks to exec into a failed workspace and poke around to
# troubleshoot.
waitonexit() {
	echo "=== Agent script exited with non-zero code ($?). Sleeping 24h to preserve logs..."
	sleep 86400
}
trap waitonexit EXIT
BINARY_DIR="${BINARY_DIR:-$(mktemp -d -t coder.XXXXXX)}"
BINARY_NAME=coder
BINARY_URL=https://coder-apexalgo.ardenone.com/bin/coder-linux-amd64
cd "$BINARY_DIR"
# Attempt to download the coder agent.
# This could fail for a number of reasons, many of which are likely transient.
# So just keep trying!
while :; do
	# Try a number of different download tools, as we don not know what we
	# will have available.
	status=""
	if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
		curl -fsSL --compressed "${BINARY_URL}" -o "${BINARY_NAME}" && break
		status=$?
	elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
		wget -q "${BINARY_URL}" -O "${BINARY_NAME}" && break
		status=$?
	elif command -v busybox >/dev/null 2>&1; then
		busybox wget -q "${BINARY_URL}" -O "${BINARY_NAME}" && break
		status=$?
	else
		echo "error: no download tool found, please install curl, wget or busybox wget"
		exit 127
	fi
	echo "error: failed to download coder agent"
	echo "       command returned: ${status}"
	echo "Trying again in 30 seconds..."
	sleep 30
done

if ! chmod +x $BINARY_NAME; then
	echo "Failed to make $BINARY_NAME executable"
	exit 1
fi

haslibcap2() {
	command -v setcap /dev/null 2>&1
	command -v capsh /dev/null 2>&1
}
printnetadminmissing() {
	echo "The root user does not have CAP_NET_ADMIN permission. " + \
		"If running in Docker, add the capability to the container for " + \
		"improved network performance."
	echo "This has security implications. See https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/capabilities.7.html"
}

# Attempt to add CAP_NET_ADMIN to the agent binary. This allows us to increase
# network buffers which improves network transfer speeds.
if [ -n "${USE_CAP_NET_ADMIN:-}" ]; then
	# If running as root, we do not need to do anything.
	if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
		echo "Running as root, skipping setcap"
		# Warn the user if root does not have CAP_NET_ADMIN.
		if ! capsh --has-p=CAP_NET_ADMIN; then
			printnetadminmissing
		fi

	# If not running as root, make sure we have sudo perms and the "setcap" +
	# "capsh" binaries exist.
	elif sudo -nl && haslibcap2; then
		# Make sure the root user has CAP_NET_ADMIN.
		if sudo -n capsh --has-p=CAP_NET_ADMIN; then
			sudo -n setcap CAP_NET_ADMIN=+ep ./$BINARY_NAME || true
		else
			printnetadminmissing
		fi

	# If we are not running as root, cant sudo, and "setcap" does not exist, we
	# cannot do anything.
	else
		echo "Unable to setcap agent binary. To enable improved network performance, " + \
			"give the agent passwordless sudo permissions and the \"setcap\" + \"capsh\" binaries."
		echo "This has security implications. See https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/capabilities.7.html"
	fi
fi

export CODER_AGENT_AUTH="token"
export CODER_AGENT_URL="https://coder-apexalgo.ardenone.com/"

output=$(./${BINARY_NAME} --version | head -n1)
if ! echo "${output}" | grep -q Coder; then
	echo >&2 "ERROR: Downloaded agent binary returned unexpected version output"
	echo >&2 "${BINARY_NAME} --version output: \"${output}\""
	exit 2
fi

exec ./${BINARY_NAME} agent

#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "=========================================="
echo "DevPod RoleBinding Controller Starting"
echo "Version: 1.3.0"
echo "Target: devpod:default and devpod:claude-code-diagnostics"
echo "ClusterRole: mcp-k8s-observer-namespace-resources"
echo "Auto-restart: Every 15 minutes"
echo "=========================================="

if [ -f /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token ]; then
  echo "✓ ServiceAccount token found"
else
  echo "✗ ServiceAccount token NOT found!"
  exit 1
fi

if timeout 10 kubectl get --raw /healthz &>/dev/null; then
  echo "✓ API server reachable"
else
  echo "Waiting 10 seconds for RBAC to sync..."
  sleep 10
fi

if timeout 10 kubectl get namespaces -o name | head -1 &>/dev/null; then
  NAMESPACE_COUNT=$(kubectl get namespaces -o name | wc -l)
  echo "✓ Can list namespaces (found $NAMESPACE_COUNT namespaces)"
else
  echo "✗ Cannot list namespaces!"
  exit 1
fi

START_TIME=$(date +%s)
RESTART_INTERVAL=900

is_namespace_accessible() {
  local ns=$1
  local error_output
  error_output=$(timeout 5 kubectl get namespace "$ns" -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}' 2>&1)
  local exit_code=$?
  if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  if [ "$error_output" = "Terminating" ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  return 1
}

is_denied() {
  local ns=$1
  if kubectl get namespace "$ns" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels.k8s-observer-denied}' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "true"; then
    return 0
  fi
  local denylist=" kube-system kube-public kube-node-lease argocd traefik sealedsecrets cert-manager ingress-nginx kubernetes-dashboard "
  if [[ "$denylist" == *" $ns "* ]]; then
    return 0
  fi
  return 1
}

create_rolebinding() {
  local ns=$1
  if is_namespace_accessible "$ns"; then
    return 2
  fi
  timeout 10 kubectl apply -f - 2>&1 <<-EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: k8s-observer-devpod-binding
  namespace: $ns
  labels:
    app: k8s-observer
    managed-by: rolebinding-controller
    auto-generated: "true"
  annotations:
    controller-version: "1.3.0"
    generated-at: "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: default
  namespace: devpod
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: claude-code-diagnostics
  namespace: devpod
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: mcp-k8s-observer-namespace-resources
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
EOF
}

delete_rolebinding() {
  local ns=$1
  timeout 10 kubectl delete rolebinding k8s-observer-devpod-binding -n "$ns" --ignore-not-found=true 2>&1
}

reconcile_namespace() {
  local ns=$1
  set +e
  if is_namespace_accessible "$ns"; then
    set -e
    return 0
  fi
  if is_denied "$ns"; then
    if timeout 5 kubectl get rolebinding k8s-observer-devpod-binding -n "$ns" &>/dev/null; then
      delete_rolebinding "$ns" || true
    fi
  else
    if ! timeout 5 kubectl get rolebinding k8s-observer-devpod-binding -n "$ns" &>/dev/null; then
      create_rolebinding "$ns" || true
    fi
  fi
  set -e
}

echo ""
echo "Starting Initial Sync..."
NAMESPACES=$(kubectl get namespaces -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}')
for ns in $NAMESPACES; do
  set +e
  if is_namespace_accessible "$ns"; then
    set -e
    continue
  fi
  if is_denied "$ns"; then
    if timeout 5 kubectl get rolebinding k8s-observer-devpod-binding -n "$ns" &>/dev/null; then
      delete_rolebinding "$ns" || true
    fi
  else
    if ! timeout 5 kubectl get rolebinding k8s-observer-devpod-binding -n "$ns" &>/dev/null; then
      create_rolebinding "$ns" || true
    fi
  fi
  set -e
done
echo "Initial Sync Complete"
echo ""

while true; do
  CURRENT_TIME=$(date +%s)
  ELAPSED=$((CURRENT_TIME - START_TIME))
  if [ $ELAPSED -ge $RESTART_INTERVAL ]; then
    echo "Auto-restart: 15 minutes elapsed"
    exit 0
  fi

  kubectl get namespaces --watch --output-watch-events -o json 2>&1 | while read -r line; do
    if [ -z "$line" ]; then continue; fi
    event_type=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.type // empty' 2>/dev/null) || continue
    ns_name=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.object.metadata.name // empty' 2>/dev/null) || continue
    if [ -z "$event_type" ] || [ -z "$ns_name" ]; then continue; fi
    case "$event_type" in
      ADDED|MODIFIED) reconcile_namespace "$ns_name" ;;
    esac
  done

  sleep 5
done

command:
set -e
echo "=== Installing dependencies ==="
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl xxd > /dev/null 2>&1

echo "=== File Format Verification ==="
echo "Fetching latest enriched file list..."

FILE_LIST_URL="https://data.hardyrekshin.com/file/historical-option-data/enriched_data/file_list.json"
BASE_URL="https://data.hardyrekshin.com/file/historical-option-data/enriched_data/"

# Get latest enriched file
LATEST_FILE=$(curl -s "$FILE_LIST_URL" | python3 -c "
import sys, json
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
enriched = [k for k in data.keys() if k.startswith('enriched_') and k.endswith('.gzip')]
print(sorted(enriched)[-1])
")

echo "Latest file: $LATEST_FILE"
DOWNLOAD_URL="${BASE_URL}${LATEST_FILE}"
echo "Download URL: $DOWNLOAD_URL"

# Download file
echo "Downloading file..."
curl -sL "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o /data/enriched_file.gzip
FILE_SIZE=$(stat -c%s /data/enriched_file.gzip)
echo "Downloaded size: $FILE_SIZE bytes"

# Check file signature (magic bytes)
echo ""
echo "=== File Signature Analysis ==="
echo "First 4 bytes (hex):"
xxd -l 4 /data/enriched_file.gzip

# Gzip magic bytes: 1f 8b
# Parquet magic bytes: 50 41 52 31 ("PAR1")
FIRST_BYTES=$(xxd -l 2 -p /data/enriched_file.gzip)
echo "First 2 bytes (hex): $FIRST_BYTES"

if [ "$FIRST_BYTES" = "1f8b" ]; then
    echo "==> File signature: GZIP (1f 8b)"
    GZIP=true
else
    echo "==> File signature: NOT GZIP"
    GZIP=false
fi

echo ""
echo "=== Content Verification ==="

# Try to read as parquet
if $GZIP; then
    echo "Decompressing and checking as parquet..."
    if gunzip -c /data/enriched_file.gzip | head -c 4 | xxd; then
        PARQUET_MAGIC=$(gunzip -c /data/enriched_file.gzip | head -c 4 | xxd -p)
        echo "Decompressed first 4 bytes (hex): $PARQUET_MAGIC"

        if [ "$PARQUET_MAGIC" = "50415231" ]; then
            echo "==> Content: PARQUET (PAR1)"
            echo "==> CONCLUSION: File is GZIPPED PARQUET"
            echo "SUCCESS" > /data/result.txt
        else
            echo "==> Content: NOT PARQUET"
            echo "FAILURE" > /data/result.txt
        fi
    fi
else
    # Check if it's raw parquet
    echo "Checking as raw parquet..."
    PARQUET_MAGIC=$(head -c 4 /data/enriched_file.gzip | xxd -p)
    echo "First 4 bytes (hex): $PARQUET_MAGIC"

    if [ "$PARQUET_MAGIC" = "50415231" ]; then
        echo "==> Content: RAW PARQUET (PAR1)"
        echo "==> CONCLUSION: File is RAW PARQUET (not gzipped)"
        echo "RAW_PARQUET" > /data/result.txt
    else
        echo "==> CONCLUSION: Unknown file format"
        echo "UNKNOWN" > /data/result.txt
    fi
fi

echo ""
echo "=== Summary ==="
cat /data/result.txt

# Keep container running for log inspection
echo ""
echo "Verification complete. Sleeping for logs..."
sleep 3600

python3 << 'PYTHON_SCRIPT'
import asyncio
import json
import time
import ssl
import aiohttp
import websockets
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# Endpoints
WS_URL = "wss://ws-subscriptions-clob.polymarket.com/ws/market"
GAMMA_API = "https://gamma-api.polymarket.com"
CLOB_API = "https://clob.polymarket.com"

def ms(seconds):
    return f"{seconds * 1000:.2f}ms"

async def test_http_latency():
    """Test HTTP API latency"""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("HTTP API LATENCY TESTS")
    print("=" * 60)

    endpoints = [
        ("Gamma API /markets", f"{GAMMA_API}/markets?limit=1"),
        ("CLOB API /", f"{CLOB_API}/"),
        ("CLOB API /book", f"{CLOB_API}/book?token_id=21742633143463906290569050155826241533067272736897614950488156847949938836455"),
        ("CLOB API /midpoint", f"{CLOB_API}/midpoint?token_id=21742633143463906290569050155826241533067272736897614950488156847949938836455"),
    ]

    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        for name, url in endpoints:
            times = []
            for i in range(3):
                start = time.perf_counter()
                try:
                    async with session.get(url) as resp:
                        await resp.read()
                        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
                        times.append(elapsed)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"  {name}: ERROR - {e}")
                    break
            if times:
                avg = sum(times) / len(times)
                print(f"  {name}: avg={ms(avg)} (samples: {', '.join(ms(t) for t in times)})")

async def test_websocket_latency():
    """Test WebSocket connection and message latency"""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("WEBSOCKET LATENCY TESTS")
    print("=" * 60)

    # First get a valid token ID
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        async with session.get(f"{GAMMA_API}/markets?limit=1&closed=false") as resp:
            markets = await resp.json()
            if not markets:
                print("  ERROR: No markets found")
                return
            token_id = markets[0].get("clobTokenIds", [None])[0]
            if not token_id:
                print("  ERROR: No token ID found")
                return
            print(f"  Using token: {token_id[:20]}...")

    # Test connection time
    print("\n  --- WebSocket Connection ---")
    for i in range(3):
        start = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            async with websockets.connect(WS_URL, ping_interval=None) as ws:
                connected = time.perf_counter()
                print(f"  Connection #{i+1}: {ms(connected - start)}")

                # Subscribe and measure first message
                sub_start = time.perf_counter()
                await ws.send(json.dumps({"assets_ids": [token_id], "type": "market"}))
                sub_sent = time.perf_counter()

                # Wait for first message (with timeout)
                try:
                    msg = await asyncio.wait_for(ws.recv(), timeout=10.0)
                    first_msg = time.perf_counter()
                    print(f"    Subscribe send: {ms(sub_sent - sub_start)}")
                    print(f"    First message:  {ms(first_msg - sub_sent)}")
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    print(f"    First message: TIMEOUT (no data in 10s)")

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  Connection #{i+1}: ERROR - {e}")

    # Test message-to-message latency (if we get continuous updates)
    print("\n  --- Message Stream Latency (10 messages) ---")
    try:
        async with websockets.connect(WS_URL, ping_interval=None) as ws:
            await ws.send(json.dumps({"assets_ids": [token_id], "type": "market"}))

            last_time = None
            intervals = []
            msg_count = 0

            async def receive_messages():
                nonlocal last_time, msg_count
                while msg_count < 10:
                    msg = await ws.recv()
                    now = time.perf_counter()
                    if last_time:
                        intervals.append(now - last_time)
                    last_time = now
                    msg_count += 1

            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(receive_messages(), timeout=30.0)
                if intervals:
                    avg_interval = sum(intervals) / len(intervals)
                    print(f"  Received {msg_count} messages")
                    print(f"  Avg interval: {ms(avg_interval)}")
                    print(f"  Min interval: {ms(min(intervals))}")
                    print(f"  Max interval: {ms(max(intervals))}")
                else:
                    print(f"  Only received {msg_count} message(s)")
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                print(f"  Timeout after {msg_count} messages in 30s")
                if intervals:
                    print(f"  Avg interval: {ms(sum(intervals) / len(intervals))}")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  ERROR: {e}")

async def test_trade_api_latency():
    """Test trade submission API latency (read-only endpoints)"""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)

    ]

    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        for name, url in endpoints:
            times = []
            for i in range(5):
                start = time.perf_counter()
                try:

                        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start

            try:
                async with session.post(
                    f"{CLOB_API}/order",
                    json={"test": "latency"},
                    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
                ) as resp:

async def test_connection_idle_timeout():
    """Test how long HTTP connections stay alive when idle"""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("CONNECTION IDLE TIMEOUT TEST")
    print("=" * 60)
    print("  Testing how long server keeps connection alive...\n")

    connector = aiohttp.TCPConnector(limit=1, keepalive_timeout=600)
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession(connector=connector) as session:
        # First request - establishes connection
        start = time.perf_counter()
        async with session.get(f"{CLOB_API}/time") as resp:
            await resp.read()
        print(f"  Request 1 (new conn): {ms(time.perf_counter() - start)}")

        # Immediate reuse
        start = time.perf_counter()
        async with session.get(f"{CLOB_API}/time") as resp:
            await resp.read()
        print(f"  Request 2 (immediate): {ms(time.perf_counter() - start)}")

        # Test at various idle intervals
        for idle_secs in [30, 60, 90, 120]:
            print(f"\n  Waiting {idle_secs}s...")
            await asyncio.sleep(idle_secs)

            start = time.perf_counter()
            async with session.get(f"{CLOB_API}/time") as resp:
                await resp.read()
            elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start

            # If elapsed > 200ms, likely needed new connection
            status = "ALIVE (reused)" if elapsed < 0.2 else "RECONNECTED"
            print(f"  Request after {idle_secs}s: {ms(elapsed)} - {status}")
